name: amda-skill
description: The Augmented Marketing Decision Architecture, packaged as an installable agent skill. Sorts marketing and go-to-market decisions into three AI governance zones.

plugins.name: amda-decision-router
plugins.description: Routes marketing and go-to-market decisions into three AI governance zones (AI-Primary, Collaborative, Human-Primary) by reversibility, exposure and frequency. States the governance rule for each zone and the cost of getting it wrong. Includes 24 labelled evaluation cases.
